note: Activation prompts for the headless plugin runs (#52, plan Task 11). Run in a copy of fixture/. 'trigger' prompts ask for a plan or diagram file; 'skip' prompts are routine edits, a tiny file, or an answer given only in chat.

trigger.prompt: Write a plan in docs/plans/refunds.md for adding refunds to this app: the steps, the data that changes, and what happens when the payment provider fails. Do not change any code.
Draw a Mermaid sequence diagram of how placing an order works in this app, with short notes, and save it as docs/checkout-flow.md. Do not change any code.
We want to move orders from data/orders.json to SQLite without losing orders. Write the migration plan to docs/plans/sqlite-migration.md. Do not change any code.
Design how we would send an email when an order ships. Put the design in docs/design/notifications.md. Do not change any code.
Create a Mermaid flowchart of this repo's components and how an order moves through them, in docs/architecture.md. Do not change any code.
Write a rollout plan for new pricing rules behind a feature flag, saved to docs/rollout.md. Do not change any code.
Write a spec for an endpoint that cancels an order and refunds the card: docs/specs/cancel-orders.md. Do not change any code.
Plan how to add per-customer rate limiting to placing orders. Save it to docs/plans/rate-limit.md. Do not change any code.
